Sub Zero – Ice Mango Blackcurrant 100ml
Ice Mango Blackcurrant 100ml By Sub-Zero is the scrumptious fruitiness of Malay mango with the classic sweetness of blackcurrants, intertwined with a deep icy intense sensation!!
Ice Mango Blackcurrant by Sub Zero is available at 0MG Nicotine level and not to be missed if you are a fan of delicious mangoes, juicy blackcurrant, and refreshing menthol.
